# Verification record

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance. Apache-2.0.

All eight registered normal and optimized gates passed through the canonical
research-package runner. Each authenticates all 109 vendored input files before
the source executes, then compares exact scientific receipts. The gates group
descriptor/algebra, forward, inverse, and acceptance-domain/history checks;
each has a 90-second process limit. They passed under Python 3.12. The result
does not depend on assertions being enabled.

The separate native research worker identified the intermediate signed-domain
obstruction. The implementation now states and tests the strictly narrower
domain, with actual batched acceptance and serial rejection on the same input.
A second worker independently reviewed the source, geometry and cost proof.
The review found no blocker under the explicit contracts and checked 560
geometries, 1,820 views, 43,940 selected positions, all 73 finite rank tables,
and 349,504 signed-phase cases with six controls. INDEPENDENT-REVIEW.json
records the exact reviewed hashes. The later proof delta only removes the
draft label and corrects “negative” to “negation”; no scientific code changed.
The portable review/independent_checks.py changes only the original script's
workspace path to a package-relative path. These are separate AI-assisted
oracles sharing the source context, not a human or kernel-checked review.

The numerical traces execute the unchanged monomial source. An ordinary-entry
trap is a failure detector, not a numerical substitute: successful traces must
never enter it, and a deliberate entry is checked to fail. Compact invocation
counters also remain zero. The expected full signed numerical outputs use the
authenticated predecessor's separate coordinate oracle. The new finite source
algebra checks bind both actual selected factors, but do not execute their
entire nine-axis field. The exact universal argument is in PROOF.md.

Fresh and reused shorter calls have identical actual action receipts while old
materialized backing remains allocated. Those array extents do not measure
every visited blank address and are not used as an independent asymptotic space
theorem; all source rolewise history bounds and constructor inventories remain
inherited and charged.

Committed-byte/mode and Git-free export checks are recorded in the lead
publication receipt after the tree is frozen.
No upstream pull request or accepted-certificate change is authorized by these
checks. Only an independently reviewed frozen tree may be published.
